title: Restore system using Timeshift
summary: Revert your system to a previous state using a Timeshift snapshot. This is useful if a recent update or change broke your system.

steps.explain: Start the interactive restore process to select a snapshot.

alternatives.explain: Restore a specific snapshot by name.

placeholders.name: SNAPSHOT_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the snapshot to restore, e.g., '2023-10-27_14-30-00'

warnings: Restoring will revert system files and settings to the state they were in when the snapshot was created.
User data in home directories is typically not affected unless explicitly configured, but always verify your settings.

rollback.explain: If the restore fails or causes issues, you may need to boot from a live USB and manually restore files or reinstall the system. Timeshift itself does not provide a simple 'undo restore' command once the process completes.
